name: Barbate (Spain)
description: Red field with white and blue wavy stripes above a dark blue lower stripe, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Barbate (a tuna and a star on blue).
history: Municipal flag of Barbate; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.
